api.doc: Clear the world and UI layers to transparent, which shows as pure black — not palette color 0. Use fill_screen(0) for the palette background.
api.name: clear_screen

api.doc: Set a single pixel to a palette color.
api.name: set_pixel

api.doc: Draw sprite sprite_id with its top-left at (x, y), camera-relative. flip_x/flip_y mirror the sprite (default false); rotate is 0/90/180/270 degrees clockwise (default 0, any other value is a Lua error). Rotation is applied before flipping. w/h are optional sizes in sprite units, not pixels (default 1, 1) — sprite_id is the block's top-left sprite and adjacent sheet slots fill the rest; a block that would run past the sheet edge, or a w/h below 1, is a Lua error.
api.name: sprite

api.doc: True while button_index is held down. 0=Up 1=Down 2=Left 3=Right 4=A 5=B 6=Select. START is reserved by the console for its pause menu and never reaches a cart.
api.name: button_down

api.doc: True on the single frame button_index was first pressed. Same indices as button_down; an out-of-range index is always false.
api.name: button_pressed

api.doc: True on the single frame button_index was released. Same indices as button_down; an out-of-range index is always false.
api.name: button_released

api.doc: Draw text on the UI layer at (x, y).
api.name: draw_text

api.doc: Draw an integer on the UI layer at (x, y).
api.name: draw_number

api.doc: Fill the entire world layer with one color.
api.name: fill_screen

api.doc: Draw a line from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1), camera-relative.
api.name: draw_line

api.doc: Draw a rectangle outline, camera-relative.
api.name: draw_rect

api.doc: Draw a filled rectangle, camera-relative.
api.name: fill_rect

api.doc: Draw a circle outline, camera-relative.
api.name: draw_circle

api.doc: Draw a filled circle, camera-relative.
api.name: fill_circle

api.doc: Set the camera's world-space offset.
api.name: set_camera

api.doc: Set palette slot index to an RGB color.
api.name: set_palette_color

api.doc: Draw a w x h block of map tiles starting at cell (cx, cy) to screen position (sx, sy).
api.name: draw_map

api.doc: Read the tile id at map cell (x, y); 0 if out of bounds.
api.name: get_tile

api.doc: Write a tile id at map cell (x, y); no-op if out of bounds.
api.name: set_tile

api.doc: Read the collision-type id at map cell (tx, ty); 0 if out of bounds. The id indexes the cart's collision-type table (0/1/2 built-in as walkable/solid/hazard, 3-255 free for custom types) — see collision_type_name/collision_is_solid.
api.name: get_collision

api.doc: Write the collision-type id at map cell (tx, ty); no-op if out of bounds.
api.name: set_collision

api.doc: Look up a collision type's id by name; 0 (walkable) if no type has that name.
api.name: collision_type_id

api.doc: Look up a collision type's name by id; "" if the id is undefined.
api.name: collision_type_name

api.doc: True if the collision type with this id is flagged solid. Used by collision.tile_solid/box_touches_solid; undefined ids are never solid.
api.name: collision_is_solid

api.doc: True if the collision type with this id is flagged one-way (passable from below/the side, landed on only when descending from above). Undefined ids are never one-way.
api.name: collision_is_one_way

api.doc: True if the collision type with this id is flagged slope-left (floor rises right-to-left; walking left goes uphill). Undefined ids are never a slope.
api.name: collision_is_slope_left

api.doc: True if the collision type with this id is flagged slope-right (floor rises left-to-right; walking right goes uphill). Undefined ids are never a slope.
api.name: collision_is_slope_right

api.doc: Switch the sprite RAM window to the named bank; false when it does not exist. "default" is the bank that auto-loads at boot.
api.name: load_sprite_bank

api.doc: Switch the map RAM window to the named bank; false when it does not exist. "default" is the bank that auto-loads at boot.
api.name: load_map_bank

api.doc: Switch the palette RAM window to the named bank; false when it does not exist. "default" is the bank that auto-loads at boot.
api.name: load_palette_bank

api.doc: Switch the SFX RAM window to the named bank; false when it does not exist. "default" is the bank that auto-loads at boot.
api.name: load_sfx_bank

api.doc: Switch the music RAM window to the named bank; false when it does not exist. "default" is the bank that auto-loads at boot.
api.name: load_music_bank

api.doc: Start sound effect id on a free (or, if all are busy, oldest) voice. opts.volume (default 1.0) scales the step's authored volume. Returns a handle for stop_sfx. Multiple concurrent play_sfx calls are independently audible.
api.name: play_sfx

api.doc: Stops the voice handle refers to (release ramp, not an instant cut). Silent no-op if that voice already finished or was reused by a later play_sfx call.
api.name: stop_sfx

api.doc: True if handle refers to a voice that is still actively playing. A stale handle (finished naturally, or its voice reused by a later play_sfx call) returns false, not an error.
api.name: is_sfx_playing

api.doc: Start music track id, looping.
api.name: play_music

api.doc: Play the music bank's song order table from start_step (default 0), chaining patterns and honoring the bank's loop point. start_step is clamped into range; a song with nothing to play is a silent no-op.
api.name: play_music_song

api.doc: Stop the currently playing music track.
api.name: stop_music

api.doc: True while a music track is playing.
api.name: is_music_playing

api.doc: Runtime-only output multiplier, clamped to [0, 1]. Not persisted to cart data.
api.name: set_master_volume

api.doc: Runtime-only multiplier applied to music channels only, clamped to [0, 1]. Not persisted to cart data.
api.name: set_music_volume

api.doc: Runtime-only multiplier applied to all SFX voices, clamped to [0, 1]. Not persisted to cart data.
api.name: set_sfx_volume

api.doc: Replace the persisted save blob with data (string/number/bool/nested-table keys and values only). Errors if the packed size exceeds 4KiB or a value can't be serialized.
api.name: save_data

api.doc: Return the persisted save blob, or {} if save_data has never been called.
api.name: load_data

api.doc: Read the real-time clock as (hour, minute, second).
api.name: real_time

api.doc: Number of frames run since the cart loaded.
api.name: frame_count

api.doc: Seconds since the cart loaded, assuming 60 frames per second.
api.name: time

api.doc: Linear interpolation from a to b at t (0..1).
api.name: lerp

api.doc: v restricted to the [lo, hi] range.
api.name: clamp

api.doc: Identity easing curve: ease_linear(t) == t.
api.name: ease_linear

api.doc: Quadratic ease-in curve over t (0..1).
api.name: ease_in_quad

api.doc: Quadratic ease-out curve over t (0..1).
api.name: ease_out_quad

api.doc: Quadratic ease-in-then-out curve over t (0..1).
api.name: ease_in_out_quad

api.doc: True if the two axis-aligned boxes overlap.
api.name: collision.aabb_overlap

api.doc: True if the collision type at (tx, ty) is flagged solid (see collision_is_solid) — any type with the SOLID flag, not just the built-in id 1.
api.name: collision.tile_solid

api.doc: True if the pixel-space box overlaps any solid map tile.
api.name: collision.box_touches_solid

api.doc: Axis-separated swept move of a w×h box from (x, y) by (dx, dy) against SOLID tiles (both axes), ONE_WAY tiles (vertical only, landed on only when descending from above), and SLOPE_LEFT/SLOPE_RIGHT tiles (vertical only, floor height sampled per pixel column). Returns nx, ny, and touch = {ground, ceiling, left, right} reporting which sides were blocked this call. Non-number arguments are a regular Lua error.
api.name: movement.move_and_collide

api.doc: Creates tween state; ease defaults to ease_linear.
api.name: tween.new

api.doc: Advances tw by one frame and returns its current value; tw.done flips true on arrival.
api.name: tween.update

api.doc: Creates animation state cycling through a list of sprite ids.
api.name: anim.new

api.doc: Advances anim by one frame, looping back to the first frame at the end.
api.name: anim.update

api.doc: The sprite id anim is currently showing.
api.name: anim.sprite

api.doc: Spawns a particle with the given position, velocity, palette color, and lifetime in frames.
api.name: Particles.spawn

api.doc: Advances all particles by one frame, dropping any past their lifetime.
api.name: Particles.update

api.doc: Draws every live particle as a single pixel.
api.name: Particles.draw

api.doc: Removes all particles.
api.name: Particles.clear

api.doc: Number of live particles.
api.name: Particles.count

api.doc: Construct a 2D vector. Supports +, -, unary -, * (Vec2 * number or number * Vec2), and == (component equality). tostring(v) gives "(x, y)".
api.name: Vec2.new

api.doc: Magnitude of the vector.
api.name: Vec2:length

api.doc: Squared magnitude — avoids a sqrt when only comparing magnitudes.
api.name: Vec2:length_squared

api.doc: Unit-length copy of the vector. A zero-length vector returns Vec2.new(0, 0), not an error.
api.name: Vec2:normalize

api.doc: Dot product with another Vec2.
api.name: Vec2:dot

api.doc: Distance to another Vec2.
api.name: Vec2:distance

api.doc: Random integer in [lo, hi], inclusive. Deterministic per cart run unless the cart calls math.randomseed().
api.name: random_range

api.doc: Random float in [lo, hi).
api.name: random_float

api.doc: Random element of a non-empty array-like table. Errors on an empty table.
api.name: choice

api.doc: Fisher-Yates shuffle of t, in place. Returns t.
api.name: shuffle

api.doc: Whether two circles overlap. Exactly-tangent circles (distance == sum of radii) count as not overlapping.
api.name: collision.circle_overlap

api.doc: Whether (px, py) is inside the rect (x, y, w, h). The left/top edges count as inside; the right/bottom edges don't (half-open, matching collision.aabb_overlap's convention).
api.name: collision.point_in_rect

api.doc: Whether (px, py) is inside or exactly on the circle centered at (cx, cy) with radius r.
api.name: collision.point_in_circle

api.doc: Bundle a sprite_id, Vec2 pos, and optional flip_x/flip_y/rotate (defaults false/false/0) into one drawable object. opts = { sprite_id, pos, flip_x, flip_y, rotate }.
api.name: Actor.new

api.doc: Draw the sprite at its current pos via the sprite() builtin. Move it by reassigning .pos (e.g. s.pos = s.pos + v).
api.name: Actor:draw

api.doc: Calls scene.enter(scene) if present, then pushes scene onto the top of the stack.
api.name: Scenes.push

api.doc: Calls the top scene's exit(scene) if present, then removes it. Errors if the stack is empty.
api.name: Scenes.pop

api.doc: Pops the current top scene (calling its exit) and pushes scene (calling its enter) in its place. Errors if the stack is empty.
api.name: Scenes.switch

api.doc: Calls the top scene's update(scene) if present. A no-op on an empty stack.
api.name: Scenes.update

api.doc: Calls the top scene's draw(scene) if present. A no-op on an empty stack.
api.name: Scenes.draw

api.doc: The scene table on top of the stack, or nil if the stack is empty.
api.name: Scenes.current

api.doc: Adds e to the entity list. e.update(e) and e.draw(e) are called if present; e.dead = true removes it on the next update_all(). Errors if e is not a table.
api.name: Entities.add

api.doc: Calls e.update(e) on every live entity (if present), then removes any entity with e.dead == true.
api.name: Entities.update_all

api.doc: Calls e.draw(e) on every live entity (if present), in the order they were added.
api.name: Entities.draw_all

api.doc: Removes all entities.
api.name: Entities.clear

api.doc: Number of live entities.
api.name: Entities.count

api.doc: Entities in this list whose .pos (a Vec2) and .w/.h box overlaps (x, y, w, h), via collision.aabb_overlap. Entities missing .pos/.w/.h are silently skipped (not an error) — matches the caller-defined entity shape convention used everywhere else in this module.
api.name: Entities.overlapping

api.doc: Returns a fresh, independent entity list with its own add/update_all/draw_all/clear/count/overlapping methods, for carts that want one list per scene instead of the shared default list.
api.name: Entities.new

api.doc: Tracks entity's position (entity.pos, a Vec2, or entity.x/entity.y) on every Camera.update() call. opts = { lerp, deadzone_x, deadzone_y }, all optional: lerp defaults to 1 (instant snap), deadzone_x/deadzone_y default to 0 (camera moves on any target movement). Errors immediately if entity has neither .pos nor .x/.y.
api.name: Camera.follow

api.doc: Stops following the current target. Camera.update() then holds its last position.
api.name: Camera.unfollow

api.doc: Adds random jitter (up to +/- amount per axis) on top of the followed position for duration frames, linearly decaying to 0.
api.name: Camera.shake

api.doc: Advances follow smoothing and shake decay by one frame, then calls set_camera() with the result. A no-op position-wise if Camera.follow() was never called. The computed position is clamped to >= 0 before calling set_camera, so the view never scrolls past the world origin.
api.name: Camera.update

api.doc: Load a module once: a built-in one (require "camera") or a cart file (require "ui.hud" loads ui/hud.lua).
api.name: require

api.doc: Absolute value of x.
api.name: math.abs

api.doc: Largest integer <= x.
api.name: math.floor

api.doc: Smallest integer >= x.
api.name: math.ceil

api.doc: Square root of x.
api.name: math.sqrt

api.doc: Sine of x (radians).
api.name: math.sin

api.doc: Cosine of x (radians).
api.name: math.cos

api.doc: Largest of the given numbers.
api.name: math.max

api.doc: Smallest of the given numbers.
api.name: math.min

api.doc: Random number: [0,1) with no args, [1,m] with one, [m,n] with two.
api.name: math.random

api.doc: Set the RNG seed. The console seeds to 1 by default at cart load, so runs are deterministic unless a cart calls this itself (e.g. math.randomseed(os.time()) for per-run variety).
api.name: math.randomseed

api.doc: Floating-point infinity.
api.name: math.huge

api.doc: Substring from index i to j (inclusive, 1-based).
api.name: string.sub

api.doc: Length of s in bytes.
api.name: string.len

api.doc: printf-style string formatting.
api.name: string.format

api.doc: Start/end indices of the first pattern match, or nil.
api.name: string.find

api.doc: Replace occurrences of pattern with repl; returns result and count.
api.name: string.gsub

api.doc: First match of pattern in s, or nil.
api.name: string.match

api.doc: s repeated n times.
api.name: string.rep

api.doc: s converted to upper case.
api.name: string.upper

api.doc: s converted to lower case.
api.name: string.lower

api.doc: Insert value into t, at pos if given, else at the end.
api.name: table.insert

api.doc: Remove and return the element at pos (default: last).
api.name: table.remove

api.doc: Concatenate t[i..j] with sep between elements.
api.name: table.concat

api.doc: Sort t in place, optionally with a custom comparator.
api.name: table.sort
